goal: The 5180 demo works offline and answers every time the owner opens it: the daily offline walk of the 6 apps passes with 0 outside requests, /health answers within 3 s, the dev server goes down and restarts at most once a day (restarts a vite config edit asks for do not count), and no page hangs on an SSR timeout. Tell the owner only when 5180 stays down for over an hour.

metrics.label: Problems in the offline walk of the 6 apps (outside calls, fails, no walk 24 h)
Time for 5180 /health to answer 200 (30000 means no answer)
Times the 5180 dev server went down and restarted in 24 h
Times in 24 h a 5180 page hung on an SSR timeout

onMiss: Every run, once /health answers, run the offline walk behind the load gate (in apps/virev-demo, `PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_FILE=$PWD/../../.cache/duties/virev-demo-offline.json ../../node_modules/.bin/playwright test tests/e2e/offline.spec.ts --reporter=json`). Each missed metric gets one fix job, or a steer to its live one. walk_problems: a job that makes the fake database answer each outside request, or fixes the failed page. health_ms: read virev-demo-error.log; with no 200 in 30 s, `pm2 restart virev-demo` once (PM2_HOME=.cache/pm2-dev) and start a job on the cause. restarts_24h: steer "5180 materialize crash loop fix" for a materialize crash loop, else start a job on the cause the restart line names. ssr_timeouts_24h: steer or start "5180 SSR hang fix", which fixes the wait that never ends. Fixes ship as `commit.mjs --object-only --push-ci ci/<name>` objects that land on their own green run; no deploy, nothing to 5174. Tell the owner only when 5180 is down over an hour.
